findings.message: The author is not on the site's byline list.
This date is already past (2026-07-12) and the sentence is not written as history; update it from the organiser's page or remove it.
'maple ridge trail' is given two different distances in the same post; keep one.
'summer night market' is given two different day of the weeks in the same post; keep one.
Prices are stated with no as-of date; add 'prices checked <month year>' near them.
External link is dead (domain does not resolve).

findings.quote: The Maple Ridge Trail is about 4.5 miles one way, which is a comfortable half day with a lunch stop at the top.
findings.why: The same trail is given as 4 km one way earlier in the post, and 4.5 miles is about 7.2 km, so the two distances contradict each other.
findings.fix: Use one distance in one unit, checked against an official trail source, and link that source.

findings.quote: The Mountain Film Weekend runs July 10 to July 12, 2026 and fills the town.
findings.why: The dates are before today (2026-10-30) but are written as if the event is still happening, and no source or organiser is named.
findings.fix: Remove it, or replace it with a verified upcoming event, its organiser and a source link, and write it in the past tense if it is kept.

findings.quote: Plan for Friday if the Summer Night Market is on your list.
findings.why: Day one says the Summer Night Market is on Thursday evening, but day two advice points to Friday.
findings.fix: Confirm the market day from a source and make both mentions match.

findings.quote: | Banff park pass | $11 | Per adult, per day |
findings.why: This is a money figure with no currency and no source next to it; the two sources are only listed at the bottom, so nothing ties them to the price.
findings.fix: State the currency (CAD or USD), link the official park pass page beside the price and give the year it applies to.

findings.quote: | Bow Valley Shuttle day ticket | $12 | Summer season only |
findings.why: The fare has no currency and no source beside it, and the shuttle's name and price cannot be verified.
findings.fix: Cite the operator's official fare page next to the price, with currency and season dates.

findings.quote: The Bow Valley Shuttle connects the town of Banff with the main lakes during the summer season.
findings.why: The whole plan depends on this shuttle, but I cannot confirm a service with this name and route; Banff's public transit and the Parks Canada lake shuttles use different names.
findings.fix: Use the operator's exact name and route from the official source, and link it where the shuttle is first mentioned.

findings.quote: walk the Maple Ridge Trail, which is 4 km one way
findings.why: I cannot verify a trail called Maple Ridge Trail at Banff, and it has no source.
findings.fix: Confirm the trail name against Parks Canada and link the trail page.

findings.quote: Trails are free to use; the shuttle and park pass are the main costs.
findings.why: This is slightly confusing, since the park pass is needed to use the trails.
findings.fix: Say that there are no trail fees, but a park pass is required to stop in the park.

findings.quote: Day three can be a canyon walk with a short, well-marked path to the first waterfall.
findings.why: The canyon and the lake are never named, and the trail has no distance, transport details or source.
findings.fix: Name the canyon and the lake, and add the distance and how to get there by shuttle.
